source.owner: source publishers and correspondents retain their applicable rights
source.reuse_basis: already-public source records and the approved bounded release
source.attribution: Source: FYI.org.nz via the fyi-cli and fyi-archive evidence chain
source.rights_notice: Source rights are retained and are not replaced by the repository Apache-2.0 code licence

disclosure.rationale: Every disclosed value is already present in the public bounded release or its public source locator; the inventory adds deterministic grouping only
disclosure.direct_locator_basis: public source traceability for an already-public request

retention.policy: retain with the bounded release while its provenance and review evidence remain valid
retention.review_trigger: source takedown, correction, rights change, privacy incident, or replacement release

removal.propagation: remove or revise the case inventory entry when the source-layer takedown inventory changes
removal.contact: the public repository security/removal channels documented in docs/removal-appeal.md
